name: 34788 · Leesburg, FL
findings: ZIP 34788 (Leesburg) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34788 (Leesburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
